title: Each API route has one unit test file, route.test.ts
context: Route unit tests were split across route.test.ts, request-schema.test.ts and files named after an action, so the same kind of case lived in different files for different routes.
decision: Each API route has exactly one unit test file, __tests__/route.test.ts beside its route.ts, holding every unit case for that route, request-schema rejections included. Cases moved out of integration tests are merged into it, and the existing request-schema.test.ts and action-named files are merged into it too.

alternatives.option: A separate request-schema.test.ts for validation cases
alternatives.reason: Which file a case belongs in would be a judgement the one-file rule removes.

consequences: Some route test files grow to a few hundred lines.
